# Zagroda Alpakoterapii

> A unique alpaca therapy farm and agritourism accommodation in the Karkonosze Mountains, Poland. We offer alpaca-assisted therapy (alpakoterapia), guided alpaca walks, farm stays, and outdoor mountain experiences for families and individuals.

## About Us
- [About the Farm](https://zagrodaalpakoterapii.com/en): Our story, mission, and the therapeutic philosophy behind our alpaca farm.
- [Our Animals](https://zagrodaalpakoterapii.com/en/animals): Meet our alpacas, goats, and farm dogs — each with their own personality and story.
- [Alpacas](https://zagrodaalpakoterapii.com/en/animals/alpacas): Individual profiles of our alpaca herd.

## Activities & Therapy
- [Activities](https://zagrodaalpakoterapii.com/en/activities): Guided alpaca walks, farm tours, feeding sessions, and seasonal experiences.
- [Alpaca Therapy](https://zagrodaalpakoterapii.com/en/activities): Information about animal-assisted therapy sessions with alpacas (alpakoterapia).

## Accommodation
- [Farm Stay](https://zagrodaalpakoterapii.com/en/stay): Two unique rooms on a working alpaca farm. Prices from 493 PLN/night (~€115). Check-in 15:00, check-out 11:00. Alpaca experience included.

## Location & Attractions
- [Discover the Region](https://zagrodaalpakoterapii.com/en/discover): Karkonosze National Park, waterfalls, castles, ski resorts, and cross-border day trips to Czech Republic.

## Booking & Support
- [Adopt an Alpaca](https://zagrodaalpakoterapii.com/en/adopt): Virtual alpaca adoption sponsorship programme.
- [Gift Vouchers](https://zagrodaalpakoterapii.com/en/vouchers): Purchase gift vouchers for farm experiences.
- [Contact](https://zagrodaalpakoterapii.com/en/contact): Phone +48 695 545 330, email admin@zagrodaalpakoterapii.com.

## Key Facts
- Location: Orłowice 24, 59-630 Mirsk, Lower Silesia, Poland
- Coordinates: 50.9568°N, 15.3856°E
- Languages: Polish, English, German, Czech, Dutch
- Rating: 4.9/5 (47 reviews on Booking.com)
- Prices: Accommodation from 493 PLN/night (~€115), activities from 150 PLN/person
- Check-in: 15:00, Check-out: 11:00
- The farm is 15 minutes from Świeradów-Zdrój spa town and 45 minutes from Liberec, Czech Republic
- 2 hours from Wrocław, 1.5 hours from Dresden (Germany)

## Frequently Asked Questions
- What is alpaca therapy? Alpakoterapia (alpaca-assisted therapy) is a form of animal-assisted therapy using gentle, calm alpacas. Sessions are suitable for children aged 3+ and adults, and help reduce stress and anxiety.
- How long is the alpaca walk? Guided alpaca walks last approximately 1 hour through mountain trails surrounding the farm.
- Is breakfast included? Breakfast is not included but guests have access to a fully equipped kitchen.
- Can I bring pets? Pets are not allowed on the farm for the safety of our alpacas and other animals.
- Do I need to book in advance? Yes, both accommodation and activities should be booked in advance, especially during summer and holiday periods.
